All returned ordinary results rather than raising. The completed defect-lint rerun independently reports 39 strict-scalar warnings and exits 1 (`checks/audit/874aa60956cc-defect-lint-rerun/`).

An earlier defect-lint attempt was interrupted by the outer shell timeout and is retained separately at `checks/audit/874aa60956cc-defect-lint/`; conclusions use the completed rerun.

**Suggested owner repair.** Validate plain-integer non-negative indices and the declared difficulty domain in every public entry point, then add focused regressions for booleans, negative indices, and unknown difficulty strings.
